rotations.detail: Three GitHub PATs reported exposed in a chat transcript were revoked on GitHub and replaced. No PAT value was found anywhere in this repository (checked for ghp_/github_pat_/gho_/ghu_/ghs_/ghr_ patterns across the full tree before this entry was added). CI already runs gitleaks secret scanning (.github/workflows/ci.yml, 'Secrets and dependencies' job) as defense in depth against any future exposure.
